texts.zh:
这个文明正站在命运的十字路口：其恒星系中央的红巨星正在持续升温，炙烤着他们的家园。

在找到原因并解决之前，他们是否能适应这恶劣的环境？或选择拥抱这股炙热之力，将那诡异、甚至可能不自然的变化化为己用？
texts.en:
This civilization is at a crossroads: the Red Giant at the heart of its system is warming up their planet, threatening to cook them alive.

Can they adapt until the cause is found and fixed, or will they decide to embrace the heat, capitalizing on these strange and perhaps unnatural changes?

sections.zh:
真相来得缓慢，却又骤然明了。

我们的恒星正进入一个快速且异常的演变阶段。其能量输出已超出所有预期参数。光谱转变显示异常对流模式，其核聚变速率似乎在无相应质量损失情况下提升。

迄今为止，我们与这股升温同步演化。但基础生物进化有其极限。

若[capital_star.GetName]内正在进行的变化持续，母星将被焚毁。问题不再是“是否”，而是“何时”。
sections.en:
The truth came slowly, then all at once.

Our star is entering a phase of rapid and anomalous evolution. Its energy output has climbed beyond all expected parameters. Spectral shifts indicate erratic convection patterns, and its fusion rate appears to be increasing without a corresponding loss of mass.

So far, we have evolved in concert with this warming. But basic biological evolution has its limits.

If the changes underway within [capital_star.GetName] continue, the world we call home will burn. It is no longer a question of if, but when.

texts.zh:
长期以来，我们认为[capital_star.GetName]是一颗典型红巨星，但近期分析显示，其体积和辐射排放持续增长，已对气候产生明显影响，导致人口日益恐慌。

当前趋势毫无停止迹象，为了我们物种的存续，必须查明这一现象的成因。
texts.en:
We have long thought of [capital_star.GetName] as a typical red giant, but recent analysis indicates that its size and radiation emissions are increasing. These changes are already having a measurable effect on our climate and the population is growing alarmed.

The trends show no sign of stopping. If our species is to survive, we must investigate the cause of this phenomenon.

texts.zh:
长期以来，我们认为[capital_star.GetName]是一颗典型红巨星，但近期分析显示，其体积和辐射排放持续增长，已对气候产生明显影响。

当前趋势毫无改变迹象，为了我们物种的存续，必须查明这一现象的成因。
texts.en:
We have long thought of [capital_star.GetName] as a typical red giant, but recent analysis indicates that its size and radiation emissions are increasing. These changes are already having a measurable effect on our climate.

The trend shows no sign of changing. If our species is to survive, we must investigate the cause of this phenomenon.

label.zh: 保持冷静，不要夸大问题。
label.en: Keep calm and downplay the problem.

label.zh: 我们还有更重要的事情。

label.en: Get our PR team on it.

texts.zh: [GetRedGiantEndingExplode]
texts.en: [GetRedGiantEndingExplode]

label.zh: 我们必须尽全力重建家园。
label.en: We must do whatever we can to restore our home.

texts.zh: 经过大规模清理，[this.GetName]地表再次适宜嗜热者们生存。虽然部分永久性伤痕依然存在，但可最大化利用其独特的科研价值。
texts.en: After monumental cleanup efforts, the surface of [this.GetName] is survivable for Thermophiles again. While some permanent scars will always remain, they can now be leveraged to their full potential for unique research opportunities.

texts.zh:
通过调校虹吸装置，从恒星外层提取氢气，并精确调控能量输入比例，我们安全逆转了[Target.GetStarName]的膨胀，使其重新回归温和稳定的红巨星阶段。

监测结果显示，[Target.GetStarName]气候已逐步恢复稳定。未来，宜居性有望进一步提高，而我们的母星仍将继续作为帝国的核心。

[GetRedGiantEndingKalmStationStatus]
texts.en:
By adjusting the siphon, extracting hydrogen from the shell, and fine-tuning the star's input ratios, we have safely reversed [Target.GetStarName]'s expansion, restoring it to its former calm as a warm Red Giant.

We have already detected climatic stabilization on [Target.GetStarName], and we can look forward to a more habitable future in which our home planet continues to be the heart of our empire.

[GetRedGiantEndingKalmStationStatus]

label.en: Maintain our study of the station.

label.zh: 让它成为我们胜利的纪念碑。
label.en: Let it be a monument to our victory.

texts.zh:
持续观测证实[Target.system_star.GetName]正在加速膨胀。辐射增强带来的物理影响也在陆续记录。除非找到方法阻止膨胀，否则[Target.system_star.GetName]将在吞噬行星之前便将我们彻底消灭。

[GetMegacorpDesc65]
texts.en:
Ongoing observations confirm that [Target.system_star.GetName] is expanding at an accelerating pace. Physical effects from the increased radiation are also being reported. Unless we can find a way to stop it, [Target.system_star.GetName] will eradicate us long before it consumes the planet.

[GetMegacorpDesc65]

texts.zh:
我们恒星系最内侧的星球首当其冲，已被[Target.GetName]吞噬。虽说那里的原材料依然存在，但却深陷炽烈的恒星之中，难以再度开采。

我们虽然能承受眼前的经济损失，但这场灾变所映照出的[Owner.Capital.GetName]未来，令人不寒而栗。
texts.en:
[Target.GetName] has claimed its first major victim, engulfing the innermost world of our system. Although the raw materials still exist, they now lie beyond our reach in the fiery depths of the star.

While we can weather the immediate economic loss, this provides a frightening glimpse of what awaits [Owner.Capital.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们的红巨星正史无前例地膨胀，现已吞噬另一颗行星。除非恒星在剧烈的新星爆发中剥离其外层物质，否则这颗行星上的丰富资源将永远无法获取。
texts.en: Our Red Giant's unprecedented growth has now consumed another planet. Its rich resources will remain forever inaccessible, unless the star sheds its outer layers in a violent nova.

texts.zh:
[capital_star.GetName]的真相远比我们想象的更诡异。持续调查发现，恒星深处隐藏着一对亚空间隧道

其中一条将富含氢的物质直接输送至外层，加速聚变反应并增加氦的产量。这本该使核心收缩，然而另一条隧道却主动虹吸能量，抵消了收缩效应，令恒星持续膨胀。

初步遥测数据表明，两条隧道连接星系中多个区域。我们的存亡，取决于能否及时探明这些通道的彼端。
texts.en:
The truth about [capital_star.GetName] is stranger than we imagined. Ongoing investigations have revealed a twinned pair of subspace tunnels deep within our star.

One of these channels hydrogen-rich material directly into the outer shell, accelerating fusion and increasing helium production. This should drive core compression, but the second tunnel actively siphons energy, counteracting the process. The result is the expansion of the star.

Initial telemetry from both subspace tunnels suggests they connect to multiple endpoints scattered across the galaxy. Our survival depends on investigating these as soon as possible.

label.zh: 我们需调查其中三个位置。
label.en: We'll need to investigate three of these locations.

texts.zh:
围绕[FromFromFrom.GetName]的天体测量扫描发现无法解释的亚空间创伤。虽然该地目前尚无出口，但过去在围绕这颗气态巨行星的轨道上可能出现过一条隧道。这些数据提供了可应用于其他领域的物理见解。

同时，我们必须去其他地方寻找，以确定恒星内活跃的亚空间隧道的来源。
texts.en:
Astrometric scans around [FromFromFrom.GetName] revealed unexplained subspace scarring. While there is currently no exit point at this location, a past tunnel may have opened in orbit around this gas giant. The data has provided physics insights that could be applied in other areas. 

In the meantime, we will have to look elsewhere to determine the source of the subspace tunnels at work within our star.

texts.zh:
围绕[FromFromFrom.GetName]的扫描表明存在亚空间创伤。我们还在行星附近发现了古代废金属堆。这些废料稳定位于轨道上，可能与创伤相关。

持续扫描这些亚空间波动应有助于优化母恒星周围的太阳能阵列。

虽然这些数据有所帮助，但我们至少还需要调查一个地点，才能锁定问题根源。
texts.en:
The scans around [FromFromFrom.GetName] indicate subspace scarring. We have also identified pockets of ancient scrap metal near the planet. These are orbitally locked into position, and may be related to the scarring. 

Ongoing scans of these subspace fluctuations should help us to optimize the solar arrays around our home star.

While this data has been helpful, we need at least one more survey location to lock down the present source of our problems.

texts.zh:
终于取得重大突破。

围绕[FromFromFrom.GetName]的进一步创伤发现让我们得以通过三角定位，将恒星异常的源头锁定到一个带有敌意信号的未知星系。

这项发现或许最终能帮助我们抵御干扰恒星的未知力量。

如果能进入卢瑟斯恒星系，也许就能改写[FromFromFromFrom.Target.solar_system.GetName]乃至整个文明的命运。
texts.en:
At last, a real breakthrough.

Further scarring around [FromFromFrom.GetName] allowed us to triangulate the origin of our star's disturbance to a previously undetected system with hostile signatures.

This investigation may eventually help us to counteract whatever is affecting our star.

Once we advance into the Lusus system, we may be able to change the fate of [FromFromFromFrom.Target.solar_system.GetName], and of our civilization.

label.zh: 极端唯心主义 · 唯心主义

texts.zh:
定向扫描发现[root.capital_scope.GetName]地表下埋藏着精密设施，且越靠近核心处，设施的规模越大，复杂度越高。它们的材质和能量特征与我们首次苏醒时的休眠舱一致。

这些必定是我们前文明的遗迹。若能进入这些设施，或许解答关于我们过去的最大谜团：我们是谁？经历了什么？
texts.en:
Targeted scans have found evidence of sophisticated facilities buried beneath the surface of [root.capital_scope.GetName], increasing in size and complexity as they approach the core. Their material and energy signatures match those of the stasis chamber where we first awoke.

These must be remnants of our previous civilization. If we can access these facilities, we may find answers to the greatest questions about our past: who are we, and what happened to us?

texts.zh: 我们发现了更多存有活体[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的休眠舱，正试图唤醒他们，但他们对过去似乎也没有太多头绪。
texts.en: We've uncovered more stasis pods containing living [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are in the process of waking them, but they appear to have no clearer sense of the past than we do.

texts.zh: 我们发现了更多存有活体[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的休眠舱。即使融合后，他们显然也没有有用的记忆。
texts.en: We've uncovered more stasis pods containing living [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Even after integration, it is clear that they are devoid of useful memories.

texts.zh:
我方部队已全面掌控该空间站。当地居民虽曾抵抗，但其装备简陋，且缺乏战争经验，许多人甚至尚未成年。幸存者均已被拘押。

我们已着手研究如何控制那些亚空间隧道，它们似乎是一种能源开采虹吸装置。假以时日，我们或许就能解决母星系正面临的问题。
texts.en:
Our forces have seized control of the station. The inhabitants put up some resistance, but were poorly armed and seemingly untrained in warfare. Upon closer inspection, many appeared to be juveniles. Those who were not killed have been contained.

Analysis has begun on how we can control the subspace tunnels, which appear to be some sort of energy-mining siphon. With time, we can address the situation in our home system.

label.zh: 幸存者构成威胁，予以剿灭。
label.en: The survivors are a risk. Eliminate them.

texts.zh:
亚空间开采站被摧毁，里面人员全部死亡。

摧毁开采站引爆了某种未知能量储备介质，释放的能量通过坍塌的亚空间隧道涌入[event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]，致其局势急剧恶化。

不过，向恒星输送氢气的过程已经停止。情况虽然糟糕，但不至于继续恶化。尽管我们可能永远无法了解此开采站的起源与设计，但至少能放心，因为这种力量永远不会落入对手手中。

遗憾的是，我们暂时没有办法让[event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]立即复原。若想影响恒星状态，只能依靠记录还原开采站运作。
texts.en:
The subspace mining station has been destroyed, killing everyone on board.

The destruction of the station detonated some unknown energy storage medium. The resulting energy rushed through the collapsing subspace tunnel into [event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName], substantially worsening the situation back home.

That said, the transfer of hydrogen into our star has ceased. As bad as things may be, they will no longer worsen. While we may never know the origins or design of this station, we can at least rest easy knowing that such power will never fall to our rivals.

Unfortunately, we have no immediate way to return [event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName] to its original state. If we want to affect the star's state, we'll need to rely on our recordings to piece together what the station was doing.

texts.zh: 开采站残骸漂浮在太空中，它的毁灭为我们带来一次改变[event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]命运的新机遇，不过并非唾手可得，而是需要艰苦付出。
texts.en: As the station's remains drift through space, its destruction offers us a new chance to change the fate of [event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName], not with the flip of a switch, but through hard, costly labor.

texts.zh:
历经漫长而艰辛的研究，我们终于研发出基础翻译装置，得以与开采站的居民进行交流。

这座开采站已经运行了数代，在气态巨行星之间不断迁移，通过亚空间虹吸装置从遥远恒星中抽取能量，为生命维持系统与强大跃迁引擎的运转供能。

外星居民并未完全理解系统机制，也未察觉他们的虹吸目标为恒星，最终致恒星毁灭。

尽管有些困惑，但他们迫切希望离开这里，并承诺将自身的知识与技术传授给我们，换取一个安全的居住地与孕育后代的家园。
texts.en:
After a lengthy and difficult process, we have a rudimentary translator that can communicate with station inhabitants.

The station has been operating for generations, moving from gas giant to gas giant, using the subspace siphon to extract energy from distant stars to power their life support and powerful jump drive.

The aliens do not fully understand the systems they are operating and did not realize that their siphoning targeted stars and eventually destroyed them.

Despite their confusion, they seem eager to leave the station. They have promised to teach us what they know in exchange for a safe place to live and raise their young.

label.zh: 赠予飞船让其自寻出路。
label.en: Give them a ship to find their own path.

label.zh: 允许他们自行评判我们。
label.en: Allow them to make their own judgment of us.

texts.zh:
开采站从气态巨行星虹吸氢气，通过亚空间隧道输送至恒星外层，引发氦聚变反应，释放出过剩能量，再将能量转化为结晶熵，为站点供能。

导致[event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]不稳定的根源在于居民未能察觉或无法修复的校准误差与设备老化。

借助他们古老的技术，我们有可能将这一进程逆转，但难度极高。另一个可行的方案是诱导恒星发生新星爆发，使大量矿藏暴露出来，成为方便开采的资源。
texts.en:
The station siphons hydrogen from a gas giant and channels it through subspace into our star's shell. The resulting helium fusion releases excess energy, which is converted into Crystallized Entropy to power the station.

The instability of [event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName] is a result of calibration errors and equipment degradation that the inhabitants either didn't notice or didn't know how to fix. 

Working with their ancient technology we can reverse the process, but it will not be easy. Alternatively, forcing our star to go nova could expose countless deposits transforming our heritage into a trove of exploitable resources.

label.en: It's time to get to work.

texts.zh:
开采站从气态巨行星虹吸氢气，通过亚空间隧道输送至恒星外层，引发氦聚变反应，释放出过剩能量，再将能量转化为结晶熵，为站点供能。

站中居民只能口述设备的运作机制，且信息未必准确。他们在数千年前便与母星失联，或许是因为其文明已然崩溃或被消灭。随着校准误差累积与设备老化，虹吸过程愈发不稳，如今甚至可能摧毁[event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]。

借助他们古老的技术，我们有可能将这一进程逆转，但难度极高。另一个可行的方案是诱导恒星发生新星爆发，使大量矿藏暴露出来，成为方便开采的资源。
texts.en:
The station siphons hydrogen from a gas giant and channels it through subspace into our star's shell. The resulting helium fusion releases excess energy, which is converted into Crystallized Entropy to power the station.

The inhabitants of the station retain only a warped oral tradition about its operations. They lost contact with their home civilization thousands of years ago, perhaps because that civilization collapsed or was destroyed. A buildup of calibration errors and equipment degradation has led to the increasingly unstable siphoning that now threatens to destroy [event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName].

Working with their ancient technology we can reverse the process, but it will not be easy. Alternatively, forcing our star to go nova could expose countless deposits, transforming our heritage into a trove of exploitable resources.

label.en: It's time to get to work.

texts.zh:
得知我们的处境后，站内居民陷入恐慌。他们自以为在宇宙中孑然一身，从未意识到星系中还有其他物种存在。

我们还没完全弄清他们究竟做了什么，他们便在懊悔之下开始自行拆除开采站，永久摧毁大部分组件。

因此，控制恒星膨胀将十分困难。我们必须决定如何处理这些不稳定的外星人，并考虑是否给予他们所期望的宽恕。
texts.en:
Upon learning of our plight, the station's inhabitants expressed alarm and dismay. They believed themselves alone, and were unaware of other species in the galaxy.

In a fit of remorse and before we truly grasped what they were doing, they began to dismantle the station, permanently destroying most of its components.

As a result, it will be difficult to control the star's expansion. And we must decide what to do with these volatile aliens, and whether to offer them the forgiveness they desire.

label.zh: 收留他们并修复开采站。
label.en: Take them in and salvage the station.

label.zh: 处置他们并摧毁开采站。
label.en: Dispose of them and of the station.

label.zh: 奴役他们并摧毁开采站。
label.en: Enslave them and destroy the station.

label.zh: 蜂巢思维 · 食尸文化

texts.zh:
经过艰苦卓绝的努力，我们现已完全掌控[event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]的命运。如果不加干预，它将以当前体积遵循自然生命周期运行。

然而，那座古老破败的开采站已无法承受多次的重新配置。每一次调整都在透支其设施寿命。如今，我们面前只剩一个抉择：

要么将恒星缩回原有规模；要么迫使其进一步膨胀，将整个恒星系化为容易开采的辽阔资源宝地。

我们的[GetScientistPlural]将执行最后一次重新配置，在此之后，它唯一的结局便是被外力迅速拆解。
texts.en:
After great effort, we now hold full control over the fate of [event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]. Left alone, it would follow its natural life cycle at its current size.

But the ancient and failing station cannot withstand repeated reconfigurations. Each adjustment strains the facility to its limits. Now, we have only one choice.

We can shrink the star back to its former size, or force it to expand, transforming the system into a vast field of easily harvested resources.

Our [GetScientistPlural] will attempt one last reconfiguration. After that, the only way forward will be rapid disassembly, by external force.

label.en: Fix the star in its current state.

texts.zh:
我们完全掌控恒星的体积与能量波动后，[Target.GetStarName]终于彻底稳定下来。未来数百万年内，它都将保持当前状态，我们的人民也得以在母星系重享稳定与可预测的生活。

恒星的膨胀虽对基础设施管理造成显著影响，但我们已能化危为机，既能充分利用其增强的能量输出，又能保持在恒星系内稳定生存。
texts.en:
With complete control achieved over our star's fluctuating size and energy, [Target.GetStarName] has fully stabilized. It will remain as it is now for millions of years, and our people can once again enjoy stability and predictability in our home system.

Our star's increased size has clear consequences for how we manage our infrastructure, and we can now make the most of these changes, exploiting its increased energetic output while maintaining a viable presence in the system.

label.zh: 终于，我们掌握了自己的命运。
label.en: At last, we control our destiny.

texts.zh:
进入该恒星系后，我方舰队遭遇一群自动化子个体的短暂抵抗，迅速将其消灭后，我们得以近距离勘察外星开采站。

尽管外面有大量修补痕迹，但该设施仍在运行。在试图进入其中一个停靠舱时，我们与一个未知外星物种取得了联系。尽管有语言障碍，但可以确认该装置正是影响[event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]的次空间隧道的源头。

目前，我们正全力建立沟通，或许能够通过外交途径解决问题。但若是失败，我们可能不得不考虑更直接的方式，即登陆设施或直接摧毁。但在未彻底掌握其目的之前，贸然采取武力行动可能对恒星构成极大风险。
texts.en:
Upon entering the system, our vessels encountered limited resistance from a group of automated drones. These were swiftly neutralized, allowing for a closer examination of the alien station.

The structure remains operational, though its hull bears the marks of extensive patchwork repairs. Attempting to access one of its docking bays, we made contact with a previously unknown alien species. Though linguistic barriers remain, we have confirmed that this installation is the origin of the tunnels affecting [event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName].

Efforts are now underway to establish communications. A diplomatic resolution may be possible. Failing that, we may be forced to consider more direct methods, boarding the facility or destroying it outright. However, without a thorough understanding of its purpose, such actions may carry significant risk to our star.

texts.zh:
持续研究表明，亚空间开采站以一种奇异形式储存了巨量热能，我方[GetScientistPlural]称之为结晶熵。该设施利用热反馈循环放大能量输入。

若能复制这项技术，我们将掌握前所未有的力量，虽然许多人可能认为这不自然且危险。这样可能产生大量多余热能，但如果能找到在这种条件下生存的方法，星系将成为我们的囊中之物。
texts.en:
Ongoing study of the subspace mining station suggests that it stores massive amounts of thermal energy in an exotic form, which our [GetScientistPlural] are calling Crystallized Entropy. It leverages thermal feedback loops to magnify energy inputs.

By replicating this technology, we could learn to wield previously unimaginable power that many would deem unnatural and dangerous. Doing so may produce vast amounts of excess heat, but if we are able to find a way to thrive in such conditions, the galaxy may be ours for the taking.

label.zh: 该技术过于危险，不宜继续。
label.en: That technology is too dangerous to pursue.

label.zh: 结晶熵的原始应用方式。
label.en: Such primitive use of Crystallized Entropy.

texts.zh: [GetHyperthermiaIntroIfRedGiant]
texts.en: [GetHyperthermiaIntroIfRedGiant]

texts.zh:
我们完成了第一座采集能量并转化为结晶熵的基础设施。这种晶体能够储存海量热能，已使我们的各行各业在能以远超以往一切技术的效率存储、运输能量。

得益于其庞大的辐射面积与热输出功率，红巨星是最理想的作业场所，而我们已经准备好在所掌控的任何恒星系里部署这种技术设施了。

技术人员正调整工艺使其适用于工业化生产，探索利用环境熵合成结晶熵。伴随这种新经济的熊熊燃起，财富和力量也随之兴盛起来。[GetScientistPlural]们已经在研究如何进一步扩大生产规模了。

解锁巨型结构：星系熔炉框架
texts.en:
We have completed our first working infrastructure for harvesting energy and converting it into Crystallized Entropy. These crystals hold immense thermal energy and already enable our industry to store and transport power far more efficiently than conventional methods.

Red Giants, thanks to their vast emission surfaces and thermal output, are ideal for this process, and we're ready to deploy the technology in any system under our control.

Our technicians have also begun adapting the process for industrial use, experimenting with ways to synthesize Crystallized Entropy by harnessing ambient entropy. With this new economy igniting, wealth and power are sure to follow. Our [GetScientistPlural] are already researching how to scale production further.

Unlocks Megastructure: Galactic Crucible Frame

texts.zh:
现有的结晶熵样本让我们在无需危及母星也能进行采集与合成。这种晶体能够储存海量热能，已使我们的各行各业在能以远超以往一切技术的效率存储、运输能量。

得益于其庞大的辐射面积与热输出功率，红巨星是最理想的作业场所，而我们已经准备好在所掌控的任何恒星系里部署这种技术设施了。

技术人员正调整工艺使其适用于工业化生产，探索利用环境熵合成结晶熵。伴随这种新经济的熊熊燃起，财富和力量也随之兴盛起来。[GetScientistPlural]们已经在研究如何进一步扩大生产规模了。

解锁巨型结构：星系熔炉框架
texts.en:
With our existing samples of Crystallized Entropy, we can harvest and synthesize them without endangering our home star. These crystals hold immense thermal energy, allowing our industry to store and transport power far more efficiently than conventional methods.

Red Giants, thanks to their vast emission surfaces and thermal output, are ideal for this process, and we're ready to deploy the technology in any system under our control.

Our technicians have also begun adapting the process for industrial use, experimenting with ways to synthesize Crystallized Entropy by harnessing ambient entropy. With this new economy igniting, wealth and power are sure to follow. Our [GetScientistPlural] are already researching how to scale production further.

Unlocks Megastructure: Galactic Crucible Frame

label.en: Order the drones to begin construction.

texts.zh: 我们踏上点燃星系的道路，但自身必须做好面对高温的准备。适应更高温度将助我们在这炽热的新未来中繁荣。
texts.en: We embark on our path to set the galaxy aflame, but our own forms must be prepared to face the heat. Adapting our population to higher temperatures will help us thrive in our fiery new future.

texts.zh:
这个文明正站在命运的十字路口：其恒星系中央的红巨星正在持续升温，炙烤着他们的家园。

在找到原因并解决之前，他们是否能适应这恶劣的环境？或选择拥抱这股炙热之力，将那诡异、甚至可能不自然的变化化为己用？
texts.en:
This civilization is at a crossroads: the Red Giant at the heart of its system is warming up their planet, threatening to cook them alive.

Can they adapt until the cause is found and fixed, or will they decide to embrace the heat, capitalizing on these strange and perhaps unnatural changes?

texts.zh: 我们已决定以烈焰开辟未来，准备将整个星系没于烈火之中。
texts.en: We have decided that the future is wreathed in flame, and are moving to set the entire galaxy on fire.

texts.zh: 恒星辐射的快速变化威胁着母星的稳定。若继续如此，[Owner.Capital.GetStarName]终将发生新星爆发，粉碎整个恒星系。
texts.en: The rapid changes in our star's emissions threaten the stability of our homeworld. If this continues, [Owner.Capital.GetStarName] will eventually go nova, atomizing the system.

texts.zh:
火焰长久以来在我们社会中举足轻重，而今我们能以创新方式驾驭其混沌力量。科学家梦寐以求的能源即将展现，其超越维持现有文明，能助我们跃向星际。

效果：解锁新£entropy_crystals£结晶熵资源。
texts.en:
Fire has long played a significant role in our society, but now we may be able to harness its chaotic power in novel ways. This could be what scientists have long dreamed of: an energy source that goes beyond fueling our current civilization, and can catapult us across the stars.

Effect: Unlocks the new £entropy_crystals£ Crystallized Entropy resource.

texts.zh: 要弄清我们是谁，首先要知道我们来自哪里。我们需要挖掘埋在[owner.Capital.GetName]地表下的设施。
texts.en: If we want to understand who we are, we must first learn where we came from. We'll need to excavate the facilities buried beneath the surface of [owner.Capital.GetName].

title.zh: 三角定位亚空间干扰源

texts.zh: 用于三角定位干扰源的可行地点。
texts.en: Viable location to triangulate the origin of interference.

texts.zh: 在全力逆转恒星变化的同时，我们自身必须做好面对高温的准备。适应更高温度将助我们在这炽热的新未来中繁荣。
texts.en: As we work tirelessly to reverse our star's changes, our own forms must be prepared to face the heat. Adapting our population to higher temperatures will help us thrive alongside our star's fiery new future.

texts.zh: 辐射增强虽带来长期挑战，但短期内可提升工业与能源产能。
texts.en: Increased solar radiation presents serious long term problems, but in the short term, we can harness it to boost our industrial and energy capacity.

texts.zh: 这群鲁莽的外星人正利用我们的恒星，必须立即登陆夺取控制权。
texts.en: These reckless aliens are exploiting our star. We must board their station immediately and take control.

texts.zh: 开采站的居民控制着正在摧毁我们恒星的亚空间虹吸装置。我们必须建立沟通，确保他们配合解决此问题。
texts.en: The station's inhabitants control the subspace siphon that is destroying our star. We must establish communications to ensure their cooperation in solving this issue.

texts.zh:
我们踏上点燃星系的道路，但自身必须做好面对高温的准备。适应更高温度将助我们在这炽热的新未来中繁荣。

完成后：
    —添加修正热耐性适应
    —火山星球宜居性提升+50%
texts.en:
We embark on our path to set the galaxy aflame, but our own forms must be prepared to face the heat. Adapting our population to higher temperatures will help us thrive in our fiery new future. 

On Completion:
    - Adds the modifier Thermophilic Adaptation
    - Increases Volcanic World Habitability by +50%
